description:
Taskcluster Exchange Reference (version 0.2.0) – A collection of Taskcluster AMQP exchanges used for message routing. All exchanges share the prefix **v1/taskcluster** and the reference is identified by the schema URL **http://schemas.taskcluster.net/base/v1/exchanges-reference.json#**.

**Queue Exchange** – type: **topic-exchange**, name: **queue**, exchange: **v1/taskcluster/queue**, title: **Queue Exchange**, description: **Exchange for task queue notifications.** Messages on this exchange must conform to the schema **http://schemas.taskcluster.net/queue/v1/message.json#**. Its routing key consists of two parts:  
1. **taskId** – summary: *The identifier of the task.*; multipleWords: **false**; required: **true**.  
2. **status** – summary: *The status of the task.*; multipleWords: **false**; required: **false**; constant: **status**.

**Worker Exchange** – type: **topic-exchange**, name: **worker**, exchange: **v1/taskcluster/worker**, title: **Worker Exchange**, description: **Exchange for worker events and lifecycle messages.** Messages on this exchange must conform to the schema **http://schemas.taskcluster.net/worker/v1/message.json#**. Its routing key is built from three fields:  
1. **workerId** – summary: *Unique identifier for the worker.*; multipleWords: **false**; required: **true**.  
2. **eventType** – summary: *Type of event emitted by the worker.*; multipleWords: **false**; required: **true**.  
3. **region** – summary: *Geographic region where the worker is running, may contain dots.*; multipleWords: **true**; required: **false**.
